title: Pivot-and-Station Multi-Agent Path Finding: Solvability, Complexity, and Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2608.24585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated high-density storage systems (warehouses, robotic parking, plant logistics, etc.) require fleets of agents to move through scarce task-critical resources and then park without obstructing future operations. We introduce Pivot-and-Station Multi-Agent Path Finding (PS-MAPF), a MAPF variant in which a subset of tasked agents must each visit one of a set of interchangeable pivots (e.g., workstations) before the entire fleet terminates at anonymous stations, one agent per station. We characterize solvability completely: every instance on a 2-edge-connected graph is solvable, and, on arbitrary connected graphs, a structural effective-distance measure relative to the number of unoccupied vertices gives a necessary and sufficient condition. We prove that minimizing station-makespan or station-flowtime is NP-hard already with a single pivot. We present three algorithms, a complete baseline, a SAT-based optimal solver, and Pivot-Prioriti

translated_title: 枢轴与站点多智能体路径规划：可解性、复杂性与算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24585v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自动化高密度存储系统（仓库、机器人停车、工厂物流等）需要智能体车队在稀缺的关键任务资源中移动，然后停车而不妨碍未来操作。我们引入了枢轴与站点多智能体路径规划（PS-MAPF），这是一种MAPF变体，其中一部分有任务的智能体必须各自访问一组可互换枢轴（例如工作站）中的一个，然后整个车队在匿名站点终止，每个站点一个智能体。我们完全刻画了可解性：在2-边连通图上的每个实例都是可解的，在任意连通图上，相对于未占用顶点数量的结构有效距离度量给出了充分必要条件。我们证明了即使只有一个枢轴，最小化站点完工时间或站点流时间也是NP难的。我们提出了三种算法，一种完整基线、一种基于SAT的最优求解器，以及枢轴优先算法。
tldr: 本文提出PS-MAPF问题，完全刻画其可解性，证明单枢轴下最小化目标为NP难，并设计了三种求解算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PS-MAPF, fully characterizes its solvability, proves NP-hardness of minimizing objectives with a single pivot, and presents three algorithms.
